Satin muted deep burgundy barrel and cap, restrained brushed steel clip and small metal accents. Cap firmly attached to the writing end, no exposed separate parts. A slightly rounded slim silhouette, realistic manufacturing details. Place almost horizontally, cap on right, with very slight 5-degree upward tilt toward the right. Avoid luxurious gold embellishment or exaggerated thickness.

The note must remain clean and legible as a future surface for live HTML text.
